# Continual-ARC task-b5fcb303

## Verified rule
A solid divider separates two equal-sized panels, horizontally or vertically. Ignore the divider. Align corresponding cells on the two sides; emit an output grid the size of one panel. Put `2` where both aligned input cells are nonzero (occupied), and `0` otherwise. Equivalently, the output is the intersection of the two nonzero masks, recolored 2.
